why_best: A bright, translucent workspace establishes instant technical credibility while maintaining an airy, high-end visual tone suitable for a polished product showcase.
why_bad: Dropping in a heavy, dark console or a static graphics card would feel dense and disrupt the crisp, elevated aesthetic of the broader visual story.
trap: The main risk is letting the interface render as completely opaque, which makes the element feel like a crude popup rather than an integrated layer of the scene.
